_comment: How a released build is laid out on disk. Most of the app is compiled
into Qt resources, but a few directories are read from the filesystem at
runtime, and src/ResourceRoot.hpp looks for them relative to the
executable. Anything listed here is what a user's copy actually reads;
SRCDIR is only a developer-build fallback.

install_dirs.why: PackageLoader scans and watches this directory at runtime.

App.qml opens with `import QmlComponents`, resolved from disk. A developer build reaches it through the imports/QmlComponents symlink, which cannot be installed because it points outside the install tree. Without this an installed build dies at startup with 'module "QmlComponents" is not installed'.
install_dirs.missing_message: libraries/qml is missing; an installed build will fail to load its UI. Run .github/scripts/assemble_workspace.py --frontend qt6.
